pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal to rounded patches with diffuse, soft-gradient edges. Spatial area is largest on the mid-flank and lower neck, decreasing significantly in size and density towards the ventral and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream inter-patch pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform, maintaining a consistent pixel width between adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine, high-frequency 1D serration along the cervical dorsal line. The silhouette exhibits low amplitude peaks against the background, representing a dense, short mane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small, dark, circular focal point located on the posterior dorsal ridge near the rump, representing a localized textural anomaly or healed scar.
